posts.text:
So many emotions. It's time!

Video

The privilege to enioy today. I became an Arsenal fan in the late 90s. I always loved their style of soccer and their team history. I have followed the ups and downs like any supporter (doesn't hurt being a Sox and Knicks fan, too). LFG. This would be fun if they take it today.


Arsenal (@Arsenal)

Standing on the brink of history.

Video
  





— https://nitter.net/Arsenal/status/2060635569877663911#m
The three of us thoroughly enjoyed our time together and I feel like I made two new friends. New shows every Tuesday for the next 6 weeks.

Some news! Am back behind a podcast co-host mic with a new OUR COPA podcast about the World Cup and politics, along with my fellow and fabulous co-hosts Merritt Mathias and Musa Okwonga ❤️. 

piped.video/lMezRjIeZYo?si=Ccon…
I read one @orlandosentinel story online and I am now getting 20 emails from them in a day.

The @LatNewsletter team surprised me with this birthday video from a few of our podcast guests from Seasons 1 and 2.


The Latino Newsletter (@LatNewsletter)

Two years ago today, The Latino Newsletter launched with a belief that Latino communities deserved deeper reporting, stronger representation, and independent journalism that actually reflects us.

Video
  





— https://nitter.net/LatNewsletter/status/2059769403869172029#m

What old is new and what new is old.


Ben Norton (@BenjaminNorton)

Wow: Puerto Rico's pro-Trump, right-wing Governor Jenniffer González said the US military is planning an attack on Cuba as soon as next week.

She also boasted of how the US empire used Puerto Rico to launch the invasion of Venezuela.

She proudly said the US is in a new cold war against China, Russia, and Iran, and emphasized how the US empire uses Puerto Rico as a strategic colonial outpost. (Yes, as a pro-colonialist conserv

Waking up and realizing that sports is everything. The only NY team I still root for are @nyknicks since they were the team that made me feel part of NYC back in the late 70s when I was a kid coming from Puerto Rico. True sports love. This is fun.

This is genius.


England (@England)

Come Together.

Video
  





— https://nitter.net/England/status/2057748306839622050#m
Getting actual customer support from @SlackHQ is not even a possibility.

When I was running @latinorebels back in 2018, I asked @internetarchive to remove LR from database because nefarious players were using it to extort LR with demands for $.


Laura Hazard Owen (@laurahazardowen)

Several local newspaper companies — USA Today Co., McClatchy, Advance Local, MediaNews Group, and Tribune Publishing — have begun blocking @internetarchive's access.

That's more than 340 U.S. local news sites in all, a new @NiemanLab analysis by @decka227 and @HanaaTameez shows.





—
The team at @ZoandBertrand has no clue about Act 22 and PR. Stick to sports talk, y'all.
And @985TheSportsHub is talking about the "First Time in San Juan" song, and they will probably think this meets their DEI directives. I give up.
